items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: Art Jarrett Gerard and I think Lawrence Welk used to broadcast.

ctx.x: What did Reverend Turner think of your playing with these bands?

Oh, he would say, 'That was a mess.' See, Reverend Turner was a strange musical man, and he had his beliefs. Now on Saturday nights, his favorite music movie was the 8th Street Theatre -- to me, that was a forerunner of this Grand Old Opry. Every Saturday night when I wasn't out hustling with the various new groups, he'd say, 'Now that's the kind of music you should listen to.' And I got a whole lot of the old Hoosier Hotshots; that's another side of it -- the music was beautiful. We had bands coming from the…

Now I'm kind of getting ahead of myself - but there was just plenty of music around Chicago at the time in the thirties ... World's Fair; World's Fair of 1933 and World's Fair of 1934.
